BillingLevel.description:
How finely the rates of a Contract are set, and so which locations a trip must
name (PRD §5.4).

ChangeContractFromDateRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/registry/customers/{customerId}/contracts/{contractId}/change-from-date`:
the members of UpdateContractRequest (the terms as written on the
page, the `Version` the client read) plus the day the changed terms start. The validity
as written is cut at `ChangeFrom`.

ContractDto.description: A contract as the API returns it.

customerId.description: The customer the contract belongs to.

dayPrice.description: The day price; `null` when the contract has no rate.

minimumAmount.description: The minimum amount M; `null` unless the rule has one.

minimumOveragePrice.description: The overage price Y; `null` unless the rule is tiered overage.

oneOf.description: The kind of minimum rule; `null` when the contract has no rate.

minimumThreshold.description: The threshold X; `null` unless the rule is tiered overage.

nightCallFee.description: The night call fee; `null` without the night surcharge or a rate.

nightPrice.description: The night price; `null` without the night surcharge or a rate.

requiredDocuments.description: The required documents, in canonical order.

status.description: Where today, in Italian time, falls against the validity; derived, never stored.

validTo.description: Last day of the validity, or `null` when the contract is open.

vehicleRates.description: The vehicle rates, ordered by license plate; empty when the contract has none.

version.description: Version the client sends back with its next write on this contract.

ContractStatus.description:
Where a day falls against the validity of a Contract; derived, never stored
(PRD §5.4).

ContractVehicleRateDto.description: A vehicle rate of a contract as the API returns it, with the vehicle it is for.

minimumAmount.description: The minimum amount M; `null` unless the rule has one.

minimumOveragePrice.description: The overage price Y; `null` unless the rule is tiered overage.

minimumThreshold.description: The threshold X; `null` unless the rule is tiered overage.

nightCallFee.description: The night call fee; `null` without the night surcharge.

nightPrice.description: The night price; `null` without the night surcharge.

vehicleId.description: The vehicle the rate is for.

vehicleStatus.description: The vehicle's status: a decommissioned vehicle keeps its vehicle rate.

ContractVehicleRateRequest.description:
One vehicle rate of a contract request: the vehicle and the seven rate members, as sent. Every
member is optional here so that a missing or misplaced value is reported by
ContractRequestValidation on its own key, `VehicleRates[i].Member`.

CreateContractRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/registry/customers/{customerId}/contracts` (PRD §5.4, RF-16).
Every member but the end of the validity, the seven rate members and the vehicle rates is required; an empty set
of documents is valid and duplicates collapse. The rate members are required for a flat-rate
contract (the night ones with the night surcharge, the minimum ones as its rule asks) and must
be absent for any other billing level, as must the vehicle rates, an absent list being an empty one.

CreateCustomerRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/registry/customers` (PRD §4, RF-15). Only the company name is
required; an empty VAT number, tax code or address is stored as none. The company name and the
address are measured once trimmed, as the aggregate stores them, so their length is checked in
`Validate` rather than with a length attribute on the raw text.

CreateCustomerResponse.description: Response body for a successful `POST /api/registry/customers` request.

lastModifiedAt.description: UTC instant of the last change.

taxCode.description: The tax code in normal form, or `null`.

vatNumber.description: The VAT number in normal form, or `null`.

version.description: Version the client sends back with its next write on this customer.

CreateDriverRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/registry/drivers` (PRD §6.5, RF-24). First and last name are
required; an empty phone number is stored as none and a missing `UserId` means a driver
without an account. Lengths and the phone format are checked in `Validate`, measured once
trimmed as the aggregate stores them.

CreateUserResponse.description: Response body for a successful `POST /api/identity/users` request.

role.description: The functional role assigned to the user.

status.description: The initial lifecycle status (always UserStatus.Active on creation).

CreateVehicleRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/registry/vehicles` (PRD RF-26, RF-27). The description is
measured once trimmed, as the aggregate stores it, so its length is checked in
`Validate` rather than with a length attribute on the raw text.

CreateVehicleResponse.description: Response body for a successful `POST /api/registry/vehicles` request.

lastModifiedAt.description: UTC instant of the last change.

requiresTrailer.description: Whether a trip led by this vehicle must name a trailer.

version.description: Version the client sends back with its next write on this vehicle.

CustomerListItemDto.description: A single item in the paginated list of customers.

lastModifiedAt.description: UTC instant of the last change.

taxCode.description: The tax code in normal form, or `null`.

vatNumber.description: The VAT number in normal form, or `null`.

version.description: Version the client sends back with its next write on this customer.

CustomerStatus.description: Whether a Customer can be chosen for new trips and contracts (PRD §4, RF-15).

DeactivateCustomerRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/registry/customers/{id}/deactivate`. `Version` is the version
the client read; the change is refused when the customer has changed since.

DeactivateDriverRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/registry/drivers/{id}/deactivate`. `Version` is the version
the client read; the change is refused when the driver has changed since.

DecommissionVehicleRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/registry/vehicles/{id}/decommission`. `Version` is the version
the client read; the change is refused when the vehicle has changed since.

DisableUserRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/identity/users/{id}/disable`. `Version` is the version
the client read; the change is refused when the user has changed since.

DriverAccountDto.description:
The Identity user account a driver is linked to, read from Identity at the time of the request
(ADR 0013).

username.description: Normalised login name of the account.

DriverListItemDto.description: A driver as the API returns it (PRD §6.5, RF-24).

oneOf.description: The linked user account, or `null` when the driver has no access.

lastModifiedAt.description: UTC instant of the last change.

phone.description: The phone number as typed, trimmed, or `null`.

version.description: Version the client sends back with its next write on this driver.

DriverStatus.description:
Whether a Driver can be chosen for new trips and can use the driver area
(PRD §6.5, RF-24, RF-25).

EnableUserRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/identity/users/{id}/enable`. `Version` is the version
the client read; the change is refused when the user has changed since.

GetCurrentUserResponse.description: The signed-in user as the database knows it now.

driverId.description: The linked Registry driver for a `Driver` user; null when unlinked or for any other role.

role.description: The user's role, serialised by name.

LoginResponse.description: Response payload for a successful login.

accessTokenExpiresAt.description: UTC expiry of the access token.

refreshTokenExpiresAt.description: UTC expiry of the refresh token.

NightBandDto.description: The system night band as the API shows it.

version.description: Version to send back with a change.

PriceSimulationDto.description: A simulated amount with the steps that led to it, as the engine computed them.

amountAfterMinimum.description: The amount after the minimum rule, before the night call fee.

band.description: Day or night, by the start time.

baseAmount.description: The amount before the minimum rule.

minimumAmount.description: The minimum amount M; `null` unless the rule has one.

minimumApplied.description: Whether the minimum rule changed the base amount.

minimumOveragePrice.description: The overage price Y; `null` unless the rule is tiered overage.

minimumRule.description: The kind of minimum rule of the rate chosen.

minimumThreshold.description: The threshold X; `null` unless the rule is tiered overage.

nightBand.description: The night band the trip was classified with.

nightCallFee.description: The night call fee added; `null` when none is added.

nightSurcharge.description: Whether the terms have the night surcharge.

quantity.description: Minutes, kilograms or kilometres; `null` for a trip priced by trip.

rateSource.description: Whether the rate is the contract's or a vehicle's.

unitPrice.description: The price used: day or night, of the rate chosen.

vehicleId.description: The vehicle whose rate was used; `null` for the contract's rate.

PricingMode.description: How the amount of a trip is measured under a Contract (PRD §5.4).

RateSource.description: Where the rate of a computation came from.

RateableVehicleDto.description: A vehicle that can be given a vehicle rate in a contract.

ReactivateCustomerRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/registry/customers/{id}/reactivate`. `Version` is the version
the client read; the change is refused when the customer has changed since.

ReactivateDriverRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/registry/drivers/{id}/reactivate`. `Version` is the version
the client read; the change is refused when the driver has changed since.

ReactivateVehicleRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/registry/vehicles/{id}/reactivate`. `Version` is the version
the client read; the change is refused when the vehicle has changed since.

RefreshResponse.description: Response payload for a successful token refresh.

accessTokenExpiresAt.description: UTC expiry of the new access token.

refreshToken.description: New opaque refresh token (base64url, 43 chars). The old token is now invalid.

refreshTokenExpiresAt.description: UTC expiry of the new refresh token.

RequiredDocument.description:
A document a Contract asks for. The declaration order is the canonical order of
a set of required documents (PRD §5.4).

SimulatePriceRequest.description:
Request body for `POST /api/registry/contracts/simulation`: the terms of a flat-rate contract as
written on the page, saved or not, and a sample trip. The rate members and the vehicle rates follow the
contract requests; `StartTime` and `EndTime` are `HH:mm`. The end is for a trip by hour
only, `Kilograms` for a trip by weight only and `Kilometres` for a trip by distance only;
the quantities are whole numbers, read as numbers so that a fraction is reported on its own member.
`VehicleId` is the trip's vehicle: `null`, or a vehicle without a vehicle rate, uses the
contract's rate.

SimulatedNightBandDto.description: The night band a simulation classified the trip with.

TimeBand.description: Whether a trip starts in the night band.

UpdateContractRequest.description:
Request body for `PUT /api/registry/customers/{customerId}/contracts/{contractId}`
(PRD §5.4, RF-16): the terms of the contract, with its rate members as in
CreateContractRequest, plus the `Version` the client read; the
save is refused when the contract has changed since.

UpdateCustomerRequest.description:
Request body for `PUT /api/registry/customers/{id}` (PRD §4, RF-15). `Version` is the
version the client read; the save is refused when the customer has changed since.

UpdateDriverRequest.description:
Request body for `PUT /api/registry/drivers/{id}` (PRD §6.5, RF-24). `Version` is the
version the client read; the save is refused when the driver has changed since. A missing
`UserId` removes the account link.

UpdateNightBandRequest.description:
Request body for `PUT /api/registry/night-band`. `Start` and `End` are `HH:mm`;
`Version` is the version the client read, and the save is refused when the band has changed since.

UpdateVehicleRequest.description:
Request body for `PUT /api/registry/vehicles/{id}` (PRD RF-26, RF-27). `Version` is the
version the client read; the save is refused when the vehicle has changed since.

UserListItemDto.description: A single item in the paginated list of users.

UserRole.description:
Functional role assigned to a User. Drives both back-office
authorization policies and the strict driver/back-office data boundary
(drivers must never see pricing — see `docs/context.md` §1).

UserStatus.description:
Lifecycle state of a User. A disabled user cannot log in and
cannot change password; the back office enables/disables users via dedicated
commands (per RNF-02 revocation requirement).

VehicleListItemDto.description: A single item in the paginated list of vehicles.

lastModifiedAt.description: UTC instant of the last change.

requiresTrailer.description: Whether a trip led by this vehicle must name a trailer.

version.description: Version the client sends back with its next write on this vehicle.

VehicleStatus.description: Whether a Vehicle can be chosen for new trips (PRD §6.6, RF-29).

VehicleType.description: What role a Vehicle can play in a trip (PRD §5.2, RF-26).
